lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مَّخْضُودٍ is in the derivative form: مَخْضُودٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
خ/ض/د   kh–ḍ–d to twist, to crack, to cut the thorns off a branch; to become stale, to become shrivelled; to munch on soft fruit; to be a glutton. Of this root, مَخْضُودٌ makhḍūd occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مَخْضُودٌ makhḍūd [pass. part.] one with its thorns cut off, thornless, laden with fruit

(56:28) فِى سِدْرٍ مَخْضُودٍ among thornless lote trees.
